title: Zeus Juice Mortals - Hades 100ml shortfill E-Liquid
description: Hot, fiery and devilishly sweet, Hades Zeus Juice’s Mortals collection brings the warming sensation of cinnamon spice blended with a fruity cherry candy, all gently cooled by a touch of uplifting menthol. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
